alert_news.title: India's First 'Amrit Bharat 3.0' Train Departs From New Delhi To Patna
bullets: First Amrit Bharat 3.0 train flagged off from New Delhi to Patna on 11 November 2026 by Indian Railways.
Equipped with push‑pull technology, modern toilets, mobile charging points, designed for common and middle‑class passengers.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad's Panjagutta to become India's first AI Police Station
bullets: India’s first AI‑based police station at Panjagutta Police Station, Hyderabad, developed by Hyderabad City Police under Telangana DGP
Pilot project integrates AI across all functions – complaint registration, FIR, case diary, investigation reports, charge sheet, and multilingual ‘Setu’ kiosk

alert_news.title: India Secures First Rifle Quota for LA 2028
bullets: India earned its first Olympic rifle quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Games through Niraj Kumar’s bronze medal at the ISSF World Championship in Doha.
The quota was secured in the men’s 50m rifle 3‑positions event, marking India’s first qualification in this rifle discipline for the Olympics.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad to Launch India’s First AI‑Powered Police Station
bullets: Hyderabad’s Panjagutta police station will become India’s first AI‑powered police station, with a pilot launch planned for the first week of December 2026.
The pilot, directed by Telangana DGOP, will employ AI for complaint registration, FIR filing, case diary maintenance, investigation reports and charge‑sheet preparation.

alert_news.title: Niraj Kumar wins bronze at ISSF World Championship, secures India's first rifle quota for LA 2028
bullets: India's first rifle quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics earned by Niraj Kumar at the ISSF World Championship in Doha.
Quota secured in men's 50m rifle 3 positions event; India's total Olympic quotas now two.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad AI Police Station Pilot to Launch in Panjagutta - Urban Acres
bullets: India's first AI-powered police station to be launched at Panjagutta, Hyderabad, pilot scheduled for December 2026.
Initiated by Telangana Police under DG C.V. Anand; includes AI-enabled Setu kiosk for complaint registration in 10 languages.

alert_news.title: India’s First Shooting Quota for the 2028 Olympics Secured by Jaypal Malviya
bullets: India secured its first Olympic shooting quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Games through Jaypal Malviya, a shooter from Madhya Pradesh.
The quota was earned at the ISSF World Championship in Doha, marking the first time India has qualified a shooter for the 2028 Olympics.
